families.setBonusEN: Whenever you cast an ability, refund the cooldown of another, randomly selected ability by a percentage of the cast ability's cooldown.

families.setBonusZH: 投入死神的懷抱，使用增幅裝置造成真實傷害
families.setBonusEN: Reduce your death timer by a percentage.

families.setBonusZH: 飛彈很酷，多多益善。烈焰爆竹飛彈向鄰近敵軍額外彈跳多次，造成原本傷害的部分傷害。
families.setBonusEN: Firecrackers bounce a number of times to nearby enemies, dealing a percentage of their original damage.
families.bonus2ZH: 彈跳2次，造成25%的原技能傷害
families.bonus4ZH: 彈跳3次，造成50%的原技能傷害

families.setBonusZH: 讓大混戰工廠確實成長的第一步。
families.setBonusEN: Reduce the cooldown of your automatic augments by a percentage.
families.bonus2ZH: 自動施放冷卻時間縮短30%
families.bonus3ZH: 自動施放冷卻時間受益於技能加速。
families.bonus3EN: The cooldown of automatic augments now scales with your ability haste.

families.setBonusZH: 你會100%閃過向你襲來的子彈——薩科——逆命（大概吧）
families.setBonusEN: Enemy minions that die have a chance to drop a Stat Anvil at the location of their death.
families.bonus2ZH: 士兵死亡時有機會掉落能力值鐵砧。
families.bonus2EN: 9% chance for minion deaths to drop a Stat Anvil
families.bonus3ZH: 獲得金級或稜鏡能力值鐵砧的機率：20%。
families.bonus3EN: +20% chance to gain a Gold or Prismatic tier Stat Anvil selection from Stat Anvils
families.bonus4ZH: 獲得金級或稜鏡鐵砧能力值的機率：50%。
families.bonus4EN: +50% chance (total 70%) to gain a Gold or Prismatic tier Stat Anvil selection from Stat Anvils

families.setBonusZH: 經濟決定一切。敵軍在被擊殺時現在會掉落金幣。掉落的金幣每枚賦予5金錢，只能由增幅裝置持有者和其友方英雄拾取。
families.setBonusEN: Enemy champions that you score a takedown against drop a number of coins at their corpse.
families.bonus2ZH: 掉落6枚金幣，掉落的金幣每枚賦予5金錢
families.bonus3ZH: 掉落12枚金幣，掉落的金幣每枚賦予5金錢
families.bonus4ZH: 透過增幅裝置和擊殺獲得的金錢增加50%。

families.setBonusEN: Increase the damage dealt by your Mark's effects and gain summoner spell haste for it.
families.bonus2ZH: 雪球獲得50技能加速，並造成額外30%傷害
families.bonus3ZH: 雪球獲得100技能加速，並造成額外50%傷害
families.bonus4ZH: 雪球獲得150技能加速，並造成額外100%傷害

families.setBonusZH: 堆層堆起來。累加推層時，獲得額外層數。
families.setBonusEN: Increase the number of permanent stacks you gain from abilities.

families.setBonusZH: 對生命值低於 50% 的友軍獲得額外效果。
families.setBonusEN: Gain bonus movement speed toward wounded allies and periodically empower your next heal or shield with an additional effect.
families.bonus2EN: Gain 50% bonus movement speed towards allies that are below 50% of their maximum health and within 650 units
families.bonus3ZH: 你的下一次治療或護盾可以恢復目標已損失生命值的 12%（冷卻時間 10 秒）
families.bonus3EN: Your next heal or shield also heals the target equal to 12% of their missing health (10 second cooldown).
